country.evidence_quote: Costa Rica is a marvelous country that has a lot of things to offer, even if it is considered a small country in size. Manuel Antonio is one of its jewels you need to know. Discover amazing flora & fauna when visiting the National Park and one of the most beautiful beaches in the world.
